Registration refused.

Born-Green ensures you cannot register a failing guarantee or build dependencies on broken assumptions. GBC doesn't just catch regressions after an edit; it validates the 'truth' of your test at registration time.

First line of defense: instead of 'discover after it breaks', we ensure 'broken tests never enter the graph'.
